payload.author: coordinator
evidence: Reuse and strengthen the existing actual-source C++98 producer harness rather than duplicate it. Its X_pop mock currently ignores the first script-provider argument and cannot detect this bug. Add an actual distinct mutable TutorialPopupCaption pointer and backing storage to the fixture; validate both pointer identity and fresh loads after parser callbacks, preserve null callback assertions and existing diplomacy/network/gate controls.

Authorize independent wrong-provider, literal-pointee and stale-pointer-cache compiled mutation controls for each affected function; mutations remain private tests, never product bodies. Existing consumers in the fixture must continue compiling with the new proper provider declaration. Native object/ABI/reference and full application checks remain separate; host doubles do not prove target layout or acceptance.
